sources.note: The stroke table is an image; its 36 stroke rows are assigned to U+31C0..U+31E3 in block order and its last two rows (HN, HNg) to 乁 and ⺄ as the grammar names them. The author writes of the table 「絶対に間違いがあります」. Rows marked なし give no chain; the letters in brackets after them are kept as `suggested`.
